title: Retail Installment Contracts Training Q&A: Charges by Return Reason
content:
*Does the return reason change the returned-payment fee on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts?*

Yes, for two reasons. A return for **stop payment** adds **10.00**; a return for **account closed** adds **5.00**; a return for any other fee-bearing reason — insufficient funds or uncollected funds — adds nothing.

| Return reason of the returned payment | Return-reason charge |
|---|---|
| stop payment | 10.00 |
| account closed | 5.00 |
| insufficient funds | nothing |
| uncollected funds | nothing |

*Which return is read?* The returned payment being charged, by the reason the bank gave on that return.

*Does an earlier stop-payment return add to a later insufficient-funds return?* No; only the reason on the return being charged is read.
